name: Cranberry Pecan Pie with Vanilla Ice Cream

instructions.primary_message: FOR THE PIE CRUST: Line a small baking sheet pan with parchment paper.
Using a box grater, coarsely grate cold butter onto the baking sheet. Working quickly, spread the grated butter out in an even layer, then place in the freezer to firm up.
Meanwhile, place ice cubes and cold water in a small bowl; set aside.
Place flour and salt in a medium bowl; whisk to combine.
Remove butter from the freezer and add to the bowl with the flour. Using a fork, stir the ingredients together so that the butter pieces are coated in flour. (Reserve baking sheet for later use.)
Measure out 1/3-cup ice water (you may discard remaining water and ice); drizzle water into the bowl with the flour and butter. Using a fork, stir and combine the mixture into a shaggy dough.

Using your hands, gently fold the shaggy dough on top of itself and press to adhere; repeat this process until the dough begins to come together (the dough will not be completely smooth; it should look slightly dry with visible streaks of butter in it).

Place a large square of plastic wrap on a flat surface. Place the pie dough on top of the plastic wrap, then press into a 1-inch thick circle. Wrap the plastic wrap around the dough and place in the refrigerator; chill for a minimum of 2 hours or up to overnight.

When you are ready to roll out the pie crust, sprinkle a small amount of flour over a flat work surface. Unwrap the dough and place on top of the floured surface; sprinkle dough with a little more flour. Using a rolling pin, roll the dough into a circle that is 1/8-inch thick (it is important to roll the dough to this thickness, otherwise your crust might not bake all the way through). To do this, roll from the center of the dough towards the edge in all directions. Lift and rotate the dough every 1-2 rolls, sprinkling the dough and work surface with a little more flour, as needed, to keep the dough from sticking.

For a 10-inch pie dish, use a sharp knife to cut a circle of dough that is 13-14 inches in diameter. Carefully transfer the dough to the pie dish, gently pressing the bottom and sides into place (you should have 1 to 1 ½ inches of dough hanging over the edges). Fold the excess pie dough under and flute or crimp the edges. Pierce the bottom and sides of the crust with a fork in a few places. Place in the refrigerator for 30 minutes, or until dough is firm to the touch.
When you are ready to par-bake the pie crust, preheat the oven to 375°F. (Note: if you are using a pre-made pie crust, par-bake according to package instructions.)

Once the oven is heated, remove pie crust from the refrigerator. Line the crust with a large piece of parchment paper (pressing it into the seams of the crust). Fill the crust with pie weights (alternatively, if you do not have pie weights, you can fill the crust with 4-5 cups uncooked beans or rice).

Place the pie dish in the oven and bake until crust is starting to set, about 25 minutes. Remove the pie dish from the oven and carefully lift the paper and weights out of the crust. Allow crust to cool to room temperature.
FOR THE BAKED PIE: Place sugar, maple syrup, corn syrup, and salt in a medium saucepan. Whisk to combine, place over medium heat, and bring to a boil (while stirring occasionally with the whisk).
instructions.secondary_message:
¾ cup granulated sugar
½ cup pure maple syrup
½ cup light corn syrup
salt

instructions.primary_message: Once the sugar mixture has come to a boil, remove from the heat, and whisk in the butter. Transfer the mixture to a heat-safe bowl and set aside, stirring occasionally, until the mixture has cooled to room temperature, 45-60 minutes.
Once the sugar mixture has cooled, preheat the oven to 350°F and arrange rack in the center position.
Place eggs and vanilla in a small bowl; whisk to combine.
Add the egg and vanilla mixture to the bowl with the sugar mixture; whisk to combine.
Add pecans and cranberries to the bowl and stir to combine the filling.
instructions.secondary_message:
2 cups pecan halves
½ cup dried cranberries

instructions.primary_message: Place the par-baked pie crust on the reserved baking sheet. Pour the pie filling into the crust, smoothing the top out with a silicone spatula, if necessary.

Place baking sheet in the oven and bake, undisturbed, until pie is just set, but still slightly wobbly in the center, 50-55 minutes. If the top of the pie begins to brown too quickly, loosely cover the pie with a piece of aluminum foil. Once done, remove from the oven and let cool to room temperature.
Cut pie into wedges and serve with vanilla ice cream
